It is our policy to maintain the confidentiality of proxy cards, ballots, and voting tabulations that identify individual
shareholders, except where disclosure is required by law and in other limited circumstances.
Where can I find the voting results of the Annual Meeting?
We will report the voting results on a Current Report on Form 8‑K filed with the SEC no later than May 29, 2025. We will
also post the voting results on the Corporate Governance section of our website at
Who tabulates and certifies the vote?
Computershare Trust Company, N.A. will tabulate the vote, and independent inspectors of election will certify the results.
May I receive my materials electronically?
We encourage shareholders to sign up for electronic delivery of future proxy materials.
•  Registered shareholders may sign up when voting online at www.envisionreports.com/vz.

If your shares are held by a bank, broker or other institution, follow the instructions provided by that firm.
